name: atlo
description: Atlo: an interactive map of a codebase. Paste a GitHub URL to explore dependencies, circular imports, risky files and where to start.
author: Team Astraeon

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix frontend run check
